name: Tacos El Poblano
notes: not_found. Address is actually Chula Vista (885 E H St Ste C, 91910; OSM/worklist neighborhood of Bonita is a mislocation, confirmed via Google Maps listing at that exact address, 736 reviews, in the Walmart Supercenter plaza). Both tacoselpoblano.com and tacoselpoblano2.com are a Yonkers, New York restaurant of the same name (122 Nepperhan Ave) -- classic same-name-different-business trap, rejected. No Toast/Clover/SpotOn/other ordering platform found after searching. There are at least two OTHER similarly-named Chula Vista restaurants (Taqueria El Poblano at 1011 Broadway, and a closed Taqueria El Poblano at 1655 Broadway) that DoorDash/Grubhub search surfaces instead of this location, so delivery-platform search could not be trusted without address confirmation, and no delivery listing at the 885 E H St address itself was found. Only source found for the correct address was allmenus (tier 5, undated, implausibly low prices like a $2.00 taco and $1.75 fountain drink -- textbook staleness) with no independent second source available to cross-check against, so no price could be recorded per the trust ladder. Google Maps listing has a Menu photo tab with 12 legible dated photos of the in-store menu board, but the photo lightbox would not open reliably in this session (shared Chrome tab was repeatedly taken over by sibling agents mid-interaction); a future pass with exclusive Chrome access should read those photos directly, since a dated in-store photo would resolve this.

name: Phở Fifth Avenue
notes: not_found. Own site (sdpho.com) lists every dish by name across all categories (Pho, Com, Khai Vi, Bun, Banh Mi, Giai Khat) but with only relative $/$$ symbols, no dollar prices anywhere -- confirmed by direct fetch. No first-party ordering platform found for this restaurant (phone/walk-in pickup only per the site's own nav). Only priced sources are DoorDash and its order.online white-label storefront (same owner, so not an independent cross-check), both partial/featured lists rather than the full menu (order.online showed only 31 items across 8 categories with several categories down to a single item), and the two DoorDash-family sources disagreed sharply with each other on identical items (P1 Pho Dac Biet: $14.49 on order.online vs $21.99 on DoorDash; P17 Pho Ga: $12.99 vs $17.99), which is not a portion-size difference the item codes account for. No reliable price could be established from any source.

name: Adriano's Pizza Grotto
notes: not_found. Own site's Order Online page says 'Online Order - Coming Soon!' -- no ordering platform exists yet. No menu with prices anywhere on the own site. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing found in search. The only priced source found was a menuweb.menu-hosted PDF, which is the exact content-farm pattern this project has flagged before (Vintana's contamination case): dish names and prices are scrambled and mismatched against nonsense category headers ('Salads' section listing 'Antipasto Salad' followed by an unrelated 'Pepperoni $8.5' modifier row, 'German Specialties' next to 'Frikadelle', 'Mexican-American Food' next to 'Empanadas' with no price), clearly AI/scraper-generated garbage rather than a real menu. Rejected outright. No second, trustworthy source exists to corroborate any price.

name: Calypso Bay Smokehouse
address: 500 Sea World Dr., San Diego, CA 92109
notes: not_found. This is an in-park quick-service venue at SeaWorld San Diego. The restaurant's own page (seaworld.com/san-diego/dining/calypso-bay-smokehouse) lists every dish by name across Entrees, Sides, Kids Meals, Desserts and Beverages but shows no dollar prices anywhere, and there is no PDF/full-menu link on the page. No ordering platform exists for an in-park venue. Third-party sources (thrill-data, undercovertourist, zmenu, menupix) either carry no prices, are bot-blocked, or are paywalled. No reliable priced source was found for any dish.

name: Bluefoot
notes: not_found. Bluefoot is a North Park dive bar with a bring-your-own-food policy (no kitchen), so per the trust rules the drink list would be the menu -- but the site (bluefootsd.com, a bare Wix template) has no menu content at all, only social links and hours. No ordering platform exists (it's a bar, not takeout). The only pricing found anywhere was a single undated historical reference (draft beers $2.95-$4.50, a $6.00 Bloody Mary) surfaced via search, almost certainly years stale for a 2026 SD bar, with no second source to corroborate or date it against. No reliable current drink prices could be established.

name: The Daily Bagel
notes: not_found. Work item has no website. thedailybagelgo.twupro.com looks like the restaurant's site at first (correct address, phone, hours) but its 'menu' is generic AI-templated placeholder copy ('Chef Special - Daily pick', 'Fresh Salad - Crisp', 'House Soup - Homemade', 'Dessert - Sweet finish') with no real dishes or prices -- same fabricated-listing pattern flagged elsewhere in this project, rejected. No Toast/Clover/other first-party ordering platform found. The only priced source is allmenus (tier 5, undated); its prices ($0.99 single bagel, $1.40 espresso, $4.75 sandwiches) read as stale for 2026 and there is no independent, non-stale second source to corroborate them or establish a date, so per the trust ladder nothing could be recorded.

name: HINAR Dessert Bar & Café
notes: not_found. The work item's domain (hinardessertbarcafe.shop) 301-redirects to hinar-dessert-bar-cafe.placejoys.com, a templated auto-generated listing (generic 'placejoys.com@gmail.com' contact, no unique menu, no prices, only reviews mention dish names) -- rejected as a fabricated listing. Found a genuine joe.coffee ordering-platform page for a location named 'HINAR Dessert Bar & Café 2', but its address is 10755 Scripps Poway Pkwy, San Diego -- a DIFFERENT branch, not the 454 13th St / East Village location on the work item, and it has no prices or mobile ordering enabled anyway. No official website or first-party ordering platform (Toast/Clover/Square) was found for the 454 13th St location specifically. No reliable priced source exists; a customer review mentioned '$12 per slice' for cheesecake but that is a single informal data point from the wrong branch, not a menu.
